item.title: "OCARINA OF TIME'S LEGEND HAS BEEN REIMAGINED FOR MODERN AUDIENCES
item.description:
Per IGN.

>there are scent trails to help guide Link through complex mazes and areas, similar to Wolverine (2026)
>Marlon from Lon Lon Ranch is now the adoptive daughter of the (presumably) homossexual couple who was shunned out of Castle Town into running the ranch
>Sheikh is referred as "They/Them" in dialogue, making Sheikh the first non-binary Zelda character
